episode.title: Resume interrupted response streams without duplicating delivered output
episode.before: At parent 3d1eba935f6a75d9e67adf667002700c5c592ec2, retryable socket-level stream failures could only restart the original request, and that replay was blocked after a content chunk had been yielded. Consequently, a long response cut after visible answer text propagated the transport error even when retries were configured. Thinking chunks also closed the older any-chunk replay gate despite carrying no visible answer that could be duplicated.
episode.after: At d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5, retryable cuts with no accumulated visible text may replay the original request, while cuts after nonblank visible text enter a separately budgeted continuation path. The continuation request temporarily includes the delivered model text and a resume instruction, emits a continuation retry event so callers retain displayed text, accumulates repeated cuts with attempt-boundary overlap removal, and merges the delivered prefix into durable history after success. Function-call cuts are excluded, continuation state is discarded whenever a fresh restart supersedes it, and recovery stops after three continuation attempts.
episode.diff: The change modifies packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts and geminiChat.test.ts. It adds a three-attempt continuation budget and shared resume-message construction; tracks visible text, function calls, per-attempt text, accumulated text, and staged prefixes; separates legal replay from continuation using accumulated visible output; builds synthetic continuation turns only in request contents; emits RETRY with isContinuation for resumptions; removes replayed overlap at attempt boundaries; resets staged continuation state on fresh-restart and reactive-compression paths; prepends the delivered prefix to the final model history turn with overlap deduplication and thought-part-aware placement; and adds regression tests for success, repeated cuts, overlap, history integrity, exclusions, supersession, and budget exhaustion.

evidence_units.claim: Commit d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5 is the implementation-bearing resolution linked to issue 7832 through PR 7896, with parent 3d1eba935f6a75d9e67adf667002700c5c592ec2 and changes limited to geminiChat.ts and geminiChat.test.ts.
evidence_units.source: issue-bundle.json fields linked_pull_requests, resolved_commit, parent_commit, and changed_files_name_status; git show --stat d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5

evidence_units.claim: Before the change, the transport retry branch replayed only when the current attempt had not yielded a content chunk; otherwise a retryable transport error fell through and propagated, with no continuation recovery for already delivered answer text.
evidence_units.source: git diff 3d1eba935f6a75d9e67adf667002700c5c592ec2 d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5 -- packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, hunks around former lines 2681-2716

evidence_units.claim: The stream controller accumulates plain visible text across attempts, detects function calls, permits replay only when the accumulated text is blank, and permits continuation only for retryable transport errors with nonblank accumulated text, no yielded function call, and remaining continuation budget.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, TRANSPORT_STREAM_RETRY_CONFIG and sendMessageStream retry loop around lines 2527-2957

evidence_units.claim: While continuation is pending, buildAttemptContents appends a synthetic model turn containing the delivered prefix and a synthetic user resume instruction to requestContents without writing either turn to durable history.

The continuation branch emits a RETRY event with isContinuation true before starting the next attempt, explicitly preserving the caller's displayed text instead of requesting a fresh-restart buffer clear.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, continuation scheduling branch around lines 2873-2941; packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts test 'continues from the delivered text instead of failing the send'

evidence_units.claim: Each failed attempt's text is folded into the accumulated continuation text through getRecoveryContinuationSuffix at the attempt boundary, preventing replayed overlap from becoming part of subsequent requests or history.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, foldTransportAttemptText and catch path around lines 2640-2725

evidence_units.claim: After a successful continuation, prependTextToLastModelTurn merges the previously delivered prefix into the trailing model turn, removes overlap against resumed text, preserves leading thought-part placement, and inserts a text part after thought-only output when necessary.

Continuation counters, accumulated text, attempt text, and staged prefix are reset whenever recovery switches to a fresh restart, including ordinary retry paths, transport replay, and reactive compression, preventing request, UI, and durable-history state from diverging.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, resetTransportContinuation and its call sites around lines 2627-2679, 2845-2881, and 3033-3039

evidence_units.claim: Regression tests prove that a cut after visible text produces a continuation request containing the prefix and resume instruction, emits a continuation retry, delivers both halves once, stores the complete answer in history, and does not persist the synthetic instruction.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts, describe 'transport stream continuation (#7832)', tests 'continues from the delivered text instead of failing the send' and 'stitches the delivered text into durable history'

evidence_units.claim: Tests cover repeated cuts, replayed overlap in both final and intermediate attempts, later attempts cut during thinking or before yielding anything, and verify that accumulated text remains the continuation anchor and appears exactly once in history.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts, tests 'drops replayed overlap when the model repeats its own tail', 'survives repeated cuts and accumulates every delivered fragment', 'drops replayed overlap when an intermediate attempt is cut again', 'keeps continuing when a later attempt is cut during thinking', and 'keeps continuing when a later attempt is cut with nothing yielded'

evidence_units.claim: Tests verify that thought-only and blank-text cuts use replay rather than continuation, function-call cuts propagate without continuation, and the transport error propagates after the three-attempt continuation budget is exhausted.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts, tests 'replays rather than continues when only a thought was delivered', 'replays rather than continues when the delivered text was blank', 'does not continue a cut that delivered a functionCall', and 'propagates once the continuation budget is exhausted'

evidence_units.claim: Tests verify merge placement with leading thought output and thought-only completion, and verify that invalid-stream restart or reactive compression removes stale continuation context and leaves only the clean restarted answer in history.
evidence_units.source: git show d7c0d4ca7706ede8d1c8877a20343aa3e1d40bf5:packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts, tests 'pins the delivered text after a thought part in the merged turn', 'inserts the delivered text when the continuation has no text part', 'drops a pending continuation when a fresh-restart retry takes over', and 'drops a pending continuation when reactive compression takes over'

evidence_units.claim: The resolution commit reports 277 geminiChat tests passing and TypeScript no-emit and ESLint checks clean after the final behavioral revision.
evidence_units.source: issue-bundle.json commit_show_stat, paragraph ending '277 tests pass in geminiChat.test.ts; both new tests verified failing without the source change. tsc --noEmit and eslint clean.'

candidate_atomics.name: select_stream_cut_recovery_mode
candidate_atomics.title: Select replay, continuation, or propagation after a stream cut
candidate_atomics.description: Classify a retryable stream cut using accumulated caller-visible output, structured-call state, and separate recovery budgets so a request is replayed only when doing so cannot duplicate or discard visible answer text.

semantic_action.intent: Choose a recovery mode that preserves already observed output while avoiding invalid structured-call sequences and unbounded retries.
semantic_action.pre_state: A streaming attempt ended with a classified retryable transport error, with per-send accumulated visible text and per-attempt structured-call observations available.
semantic_action.post_state: Exactly one applicable outcome is selected: replay when no nonblank visible text has accumulated and replay budget remains; continue when visible text exists, no function call was emitted, and continuation budget remains; otherwise propagate the error.
semantic_action.validation: Exercise text, blank-text, thought-only, function-call, repeated-cut, and exhausted-budget cases; assert request shape, retry-event mode, attempt count, and final error behavior.

candidate_atomics.name: stage_request_scoped_stream_continuation
candidate_atomics.title: Stage a request-only continuation from delivered text
candidate_atomics.description: Resume an interrupted answer by adding the already delivered response and an overlap-averse resume instruction only to the next request while signaling the consumer to retain its current output buffer.

semantic_action.intent: Continue generation after visible output has been delivered without replaying the original response or persisting synthetic recovery turns.
semantic_action.module_role: stream attempt request builder and retry-event producer
semantic_action.pre_state: Continuation recovery has been selected and a nonblank delivered-text prefix has been accumulated.
semantic_action.post_state: The next attempt contains a temporary model prefix and user resume instruction, the caller receives a continuation retry signal, and durable conversation history remains free of synthetic recovery turns.
semantic_action.validation: Assert the next request's final two turns contain the delivered model prefix and resume instruction, RETRY carries isContinuation true, caller-visible chunks concatenate in order, and history contains no synthetic instruction.

candidate_atomics.name: fold_stream_attempt_text_without_overlap
candidate_atomics.title: Accumulate repeated continuation attempts without duplicated overlap
candidate_atomics.description: Fold each failed attempt's visible text into the running prefix at the attempt boundary, removing any tail replay before that prefix is reused.

semantic_action.intent: Preserve all unique response fragments across multiple interrupted continuation attempts without duplicating replayed text.
semantic_action.pre_state: A continuation or initial attempt has ended in a cut after delivering zero or more text chunks, and an earlier accumulated prefix may exist.
semantic_action.post_state: The accumulated prefix contains the unique ordered response produced through the failed attempt, and the per-attempt buffer is empty for the next attempt.
semantic_action.validation: Simulate an intermediate continuation that repeats the previous tail and is cut again; assert the following request and durable history contain each fragment exactly once.

candidate_atomics.name: reconcile_continuation_with_durable_state
candidate_atomics.title: Reconcile successful or superseded continuation state
candidate_atomics.description: On success, merge the delivered prefix into the final model turn with overlap and part ordering preserved; when a fresh restart supersedes continuation, clear all staged state before resending.

semantic_action.intent: Keep caller-visible output, subsequent conversation context, and durable history consistent across continuation success or recovery-mode replacement.
semantic_action.module_role: conversation history and recovery lifecycle owner
semantic_action.pre_state: Continuation state is staged and either the resumed attempt has succeeded or another recovery path is replacing it with a fresh restart.
semantic_action.post_state: After success, durable history contains one complete model response with no duplicate overlap or synthetic recovery turn; after supersession, stale delivered text and continuation metadata are absent from both the next request and final history.
semantic_action.validation: Assert complete history for normal, leading-thought, and thought-only completion shapes; assert invalid-stream and compression restarts omit the discarded prefix and store only the clean restarted answer.

candidate_workflows.name: recover_mid_response_transport_cut
candidate_workflows.title: Recover a response stream cut after output may have reached the caller
candidate_workflows.description: A bounded partial-order workflow for distinguishing safe replay from state-preserving continuation, accumulating repeated attempts, and reconciling caller-visible output with durable conversation history.

workflow_graph.goal: Complete or safely terminate a streaming response after a retryable connection cut without duplicating delivered output, losing caller-visible text, creating invalid structured-call ordering, or corrupting durable history.
when_to_use: A response stream can terminate because of a retryable socket or transport failure after streaming has begun.
The stream owner can distinguish visible answer text from internal reasoning or blank output.
The request layer can issue a new attempt and the consumer supports distinct fresh-retry and continuation-retry semantics.
The conversation owner can reconcile the successful resumed response with text delivered before the final attempt.
anti_goals: Do not blindly replay a request after nonblank answer text has reached the caller.
Do not persist synthetic model-prefix or resume-instruction turns as real conversation history.
Do not continue across an emitted function call when doing so would insert a user turn before its required response.
Do not retry indefinitely or merge replayed overlap more than once.
Do not retain continuation state after a fresh restart has instructed the caller to discard prior output.
not_applicable_when: The transport error is not classified as retryable.
No mechanism exists to preserve the caller's output buffer across a retry event.
The streamed protocol cannot safely represent prior output plus a resume instruction in a subsequent request.
The interrupted output contains a structured call that requires an immediate paired response.
A continuation attempt would exceed its bounded retry budget.
inputs: classified stream error and transport code
streamed response parts with thought and function-call metadata
workflow_graph.entry_state: A streaming attempt has ended with an error; zero or more chunks may already have reached the caller, while text-only partial output is not yet guaranteed to exist in durable history.
workflow_graph.exit_state: The response either completes with caller output and durable history representing the same deduplicated answer, restarts cleanly with all stale continuation state removed, or stops by propagating the error when recovery is unsafe or exhausted.

steps.condition: Run at each transport-cut boundary before recovery policy reads accumulated visible text.
steps.validation: The accumulated prefix contains every unique visible fragment from completed failed attempts and the current-attempt buffer is cleared.

steps.condition: Run after classifying the failure and folding the failed attempt's text.
steps.validation: Blank or thought-only output selects bounded replay; nonblank text without a function call selects bounded continuation; unsafe or exhausted cases propagate.

steps.condition: Run only when continuation is selected.
steps.validation: The next request carries the accumulated prefix and resume instruction, RETRY is marked as continuation, and synthetic turns are absent from durable history.

steps.condition: On successful continuation, merge the prefix into history; whenever another path supersedes staged continuation, reset it before the fresh request.
steps.validation: Success produces one complete deduplicated model turn with correct thought/text ordering; supersession produces a clean request and history with no discarded prefix.

validation_ladder: Unit-test recovery-mode boundaries: no output, thought-only, blank text, visible text, function call, and exhausted budgets.
Verify continuation request construction and consumer event semantics after one visible-text cut.
Verify repeated cuts, including attempts that replay an earlier tail, yield only continuation retries and carry one deduplicated accumulated prefix.
Verify successful history reconciliation for ordinary text, leading thought plus text, and thought-only final attempts; confirm synthetic recovery turns never persist.
Verify fresh-restart and reactive-compression supersession clears staged continuation state and aligns final history with the caller-visible restarted answer.
Run the focused stream-controller test suite, then static type checking and linting.
stop_conditions: Propagate immediately when the error is not retryable.
Propagate rather than continue when a function call was emitted during the cut attempt.
Stop continuation when its independent retry budget is exhausted.
Stop and surface an invariant failure if a successful resumed response has no trailing model turn into which delivered text can be reconciled.
Switching to any fresh-restart path terminates the current continuation lifecycle and requires its staged state to be cleared.
unresolved_or_deferred: The checkout worktree was entirely staged as deleted, so validation commands were not rerun; reported test, TypeScript, and lint results come from the pinned commit message in the evidence bundle.
GitHub issue body, comments, reviews, timeline, and status-check details were unavailable in the supplied bundle.

The consumer implementation that interprets isContinuation was not needed by the two-file implementation diff and was not established as changed by this episode; its behavior is supported here by the existing event contract and regression assertions.

unresolved_questions: Were the reported 277 focused tests, TypeScript check, and ESLint check executed by CI for PR 7896? The supplied GitHub bundle omits status checks, and the deleted worktree prevented an independent rerun.

Which concrete UI consumer implementations clear or preserve their buffers for RETRY events? The change relies on the pre-existing isContinuation contract, but no consumer file changed in the pinned commit.
